jobs.title: Storekeeping Assistant
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Storekeeping Assistant for a production company in Kuje, Abuja.
Responsibilities: Receive, check and record incoming materials and finished goods. Issue items to production staff and keep accurate stock records. Keep the store clean, organised and secure, and report any shortages.
Requirements: Minimum of OND or HND CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Accommodation available. Hands-on experience in a production company. Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Business Strategy Officer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Business Strategy Officer for our consulting team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria.
Responsibilities: Analyse client businesses and recommend practical strategy, structure and growth plans. Support business development by preparing proposals and presentations and following up on opportunities. Support HR and organisational design projects for clients and report progress to the team.
Requirements: 2 Years' Experience in Business Development, Consulting or HR CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Remote working arrangement. Hands-on consulting experience with Nigerian businesses. Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant.
Responsibilities: Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations. Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time. Prepare monthly financial reports for management.
Requirements: B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified) 4 Years' Experience in Accounting Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Professional development support. Performance bonus. Other statutory benefits.
